messages.home.guide.line.basic_1: First get the data according to the risk mode you chose.
messages.home.guide.line.basic_2: In Calculate, set the character priority and allocation settings.
messages.home.guide.line.basic_3: Click Calculate to see the result, then Save loadout when you are happy with it.
messages.home.guide.line.basic_low: Use Dashboard → inventory sync (recommended), or Calculate → scan mode.
messages.home.guide.line.basic_medium: Use Dashboard → sync game data (recommended); unlike inventory sync it updates live.
messages.home.guide.line.identify_1: Pick the Console type and rarity.
messages.home.guide.line.identify_2: Choose an image, paste, take a screenshot, or enter the stats by hand.
messages.home.guide.line.identify_3: Click Parse image or Start appraisal to see the stats and score.
messages.home.guide.line.loadout_1: Make sure you have already saved a plan in Calculate.
messages.home.guide.line.loadout_2: In Loadout, pick a character and slot to compare the calculated loadout with the in-game one.
messages.home.guide.line.loadout_3: To equip in-game, pick an available assembly method at the top right.
messages.home.guide.line.loadout_low: Automatic assembly works but takes a while.
messages.home.guide.line.loadout_medium: Fast assembly is quick and convenient (recommended).
messages.home.guide.line.lock_low_1: In Calculate, choose a full scan as the first step, then click Manage.
messages.home.guide.line.lock_low_2: Use Manage to set the normal, lock or discard criteria (remember to enable it).
messages.home.guide.line.lock_low_3: Check the targets and save; discarding and locking proceeds slowly once the scan ends.
messages.home.guide.line.lock_medium_1: In Inventory you can select Consoles and change their state to discarded, locked or normal.
messages.home.guide.line.lock_medium_2: Use Manage at the top right to set the normal, lock or discard criteria (remember to enable it).
messages.home.guide.line.lock_medium_3: Check the targets and save; the in-game Consoles are discarded or locked quickly.
messages.home.guide.line.marginal_1: In Battle Report, open a saved report that can be analysed.
messages.home.guide.line.marginal_2: Under Audit, click Marginal calculation, pick the character to analyse and adjust the candidate configuration.
messages.home.guide.line.marginal_3: Click Recalculate to compare current and candidate damage; the result is a fixed-axis estimate and does not change the measured report.
messages.home.guide.line.rewind_1: Pick the target character, the recommendation strategy and the target grade.
messages.home.guide.line.rewind_2: Click Generate plan to see the recommendation for each slot.
messages.home.guide.line.rewind_3: Once confirmed you can Save plan; to have it rewind for you, choose Run rewind.

messages.home.page.sync_guidance.capture_already_:
Cause: nte-core already has a capture job running.
Action: click Re-sync and wait for the old session to wind down; if it does not recover, quit and reopen this app.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.capture_device_n:
Cause: the configured capture adapter does not exist, or no adapter can reach the game.
Action: clear the capture adapter under Settings → inventory sync to restore automatic selection, or enter a valid adapter and retry.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.capture_not_runn:
Cause: nte-core's capture session has stopped.
Action: click Re-sync to establish it again.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.database_locked:
Cause: this account's database is held by another program or a leftover process of this one.
Fix: close other NTE Drive Calc windows, restart the app, then sync again.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.disk_full:
Cause: not enough disk space.
Fix: free space on the program drive or the account data drive, then sync again.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.game_process_not:
Cause: no running game process was detected.
Action: check the detail, confirm the component and game state, then sync again.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.handshake_requir:
Cause: the handshake between this app and nte-core did not complete.
Action: restart the app; if it still fails, reinstall the complete release package.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.inventory_not_re:
Cause: no complete inventory data has arrived yet.
Action: check the detail and follow the prompt for the current sync source.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.npcap_not_found:
Cause: Npcap is not installed, or Windows cannot load its driver.
Fix: open Environment, download and install Npcap 1.88 from the Npcap section, then restart inventory sync.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.nte_core_not_fou:
Cause: nte-core.exe is missing from the app directory.
Action: reinstall the complete release package; do not copy the main executable on its own.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.nte_core_process:
Cause: nte-core.exe could not start, or exited unexpectedly.
Fix: check your security software's quarantine log and the program folder permissions, then reinstall the full release.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.nte_core_timeout:
Cause: nte-core did not respond within the time limit.
Action: restart the app; if it still fails, check whether security software is blocking nte-core.exe.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.permission_denie:
Cause: the app lacks permission to start components or write account data.
Fix: check permissions on the program and account data folders, and try running as administrator.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.protocol_version:
Cause: this app and nte-core are on different protocol versions.
Action: reinstall the complete app from one release package; do not mix in an older nte-core.exe.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_bu:
Cause: this account's database has a lock conflict that did not clear after waiting.
Action: close other calculator windows and any tool using the database, then retry; report the error code if it keeps failing.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_co:
Cause: the write hit a database constraint — a foreign key, uniqueness, not-null or field rule.
Action: keep the original account data and report the error code; do not keep overwriting the database.

Cause: SQLite found the database corrupt, or the file is not a valid SQLite database.
Action: stop syncing and quit the app, keeping the original account data; back it up before investigating, and report the error code.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_fa:
Cause: a stable inventory arrived but could not be saved to this account's database, for a reason not yet identified.
Action: it retries in the background; if it keeps failing, report the error code and the account log.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_fu:
Cause: SQLite reports the database or disk is full, or a database size limit was hit.
Action: check free space on the account data drive and the system temp drive; if there is plenty, report the error code.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_io:
Cause: a low-level read/write error occurred while saving account data; this alone does not mean the disk is full.
Action: check the storage device and any security-software blocking; keep the original account data and report the error code.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_op:
Cause: SQLite could not open the database or a supporting file needed to save.
Action: check that the account data directory is writable and the storage device is online; report the error code if it keeps failing.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_pe:
Cause: SQLite refused this database operation.
Action: check the account data directory's permissions and any security-software blocking; report the error code if it keeps failing.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_re:
Cause: SQLite reports this account's database is not writable (read-only).
Action: check the write permission and read-only flag on the database and its directory, and any security-software blocking.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_sc:
Cause: the database schema changed, or a table or column needed to save does not match the app.
Action: keep the original account data and report the app version and error code so the upgrade can be checked.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.snapshot_save_tr:
Cause: the account database is in an unexpected transaction state.
Action: quit and reopen the app, then retry; report the error code and account log if it keeps failing.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.system_probe_fai:
Cause: the Windows network connection or process probe failed.
Action: close the game and this app and reopen both; if it still fails, check for security-software blocking and try running as administrator.
messages.home.page.sync_guidance.unclassified:
Cause: the inventory sync component hit an unclassified error.
Action: stop and restart sync first; if it still fails, check the check detail and the account log, and report the error code.

messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l006: Pick the owning character from the two Cycle participants.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l007: Read the Blossom 16-tier base value at the owner's level.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l008: Use the owner's Cycle Intensity and the target's DEF / element RES.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l009: Multiply by the target's Vulnerability, then round down at the final output.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l010: Record every qualifying actual Anima/Incantation damage and its element; recorded sources such as official DoT count too.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l011: Add Linko's copy ratio bonus to the base copy ratio, then multiply by one plus Follow-up Attack DMG Bonus.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l012: Compute the intensity term from the Cycle Intensity of the character who actually dealt the damage; multiply the copied part by it, then add the clamped intensity term minus one.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l013: Multiply the actual original damage by that total and the final multiplier, inheriting that damage's element.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l014: Add each entry when the 12 seconds end, then round at the final output.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l015: Compute "level base × Cycle Intensity" for both Cycle participants and take the higher as the owner.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l016: Read the Scorch stacks on the same target in the same half before this tick.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l017: Compute Cycle Intensity, the target's DEF/RES and the DoT-specific final term.

messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l021: Compute the owner's Cycle Intensity and Mental penetration.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l022: Multiply by the target's Mental RES and Vulnerability, then round.

messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l024: A 12-second team DMG Bonus window opens after the QTE settles; the triggering QTE hit itself does not benefit.

messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l030: Confirm the hit came from a Blossom flower.

messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l036: Read the pre-hit state coefficient from the state axis of the same half and target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l037: Read the damage source's panel and Buffs at the hit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l038: Read the target's DEF, matching RES, debuffs and DoT state, then round.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l039: Fix the full damage-dealing team of this hit's half.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l040: Each character fills one slot with their own level, Break Intensity, element and penetration.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l041: Each slot reads the same target's Break cap, DEF and matching element RES.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l042: Add every character slot together and round down at the end.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l043: Read the Insight stacks at an existing official Break moment.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l044: Compute one value with Daffodill's own five personal Break terms.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l045: Awakening 0 already gives one; the awakening-5 candidate adds one more per Insight stack.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l046: Bind only official Nightmare hits; nearby HP samples or ordinary direct hits are not accepted.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l047: Scale the cut by that Nightmare's candidate/original formula ratio.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l048: Convert to effective damage by the target's pre-settlement HP ratio.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l049: First get the damage Fadia actually took this time.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l050: Compute with the normal 300%/8% or the awakening-2 600%/25%.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l051: Capped by the cumulative limit; when the effect ends the difference is made up by the official rule.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l053: Cycle attribution and the 16 base-value tiers
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l054: Blossom, Nova and Scorch compare both sides; Hexed and Stain read the actual damage source per hit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l057: Blossom, Nova and Scorch compare "Cycle Intensity × character level base" for both Cycle participants and take the higher. Hexed and Stain do not compare; they take each hit from the character who actually dealt it.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l059: Hexed uses the character who actually dealt each recorded damage; Stain uses each boosted hit's own source within the 12-second window. The QTE character who triggers the Cycle only triggers it and does not supply Cycle Intensity for later hits.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l061: Blossom/Nova/Scorch are supplied by the winning character; Hexed/Stain by the actual damage source. Each Cycle card lists them.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l063: Enemy DEF, RES to the matching element, dynamic RES reduction and DMG Taken increase; never guessed from a Chinese monster name.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l065: Source tier = floor((owner level - 1) ÷ 5); levels 1–5 use tier 0, levels 76–80 use tier 15.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l067: This is a second, separate Blossom curve in the static database. A resource-name suffix is no evidence of a character, so the catalogue shows it only as the "Blossom special entry".
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l068: The static database also has a Zankou-specific Scorch curve; its 16 tiers currently match normal Scorch exactly, but it is still shown as a separate official source.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l070: The numbers come from the official 16-tier curves in the current release static database; how a formula uses them is defined on each Cycle card.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l076: Level base value × Cycle Intensity × DEF × RES × vulnerability; it cannot crit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l079: One Blossom flower's damage = floor[Level base × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × DEF × RES × Vulnerability]
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l083: Whichever of the two Cycle participants has the higher "Cycle Intensity × level base".
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l084: The Blossom source tier at the owner's level; 9,000 at level 80.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l085: The owner's Cycle Intensity at the hit; not the other participant's, and not added together.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l086: Character level and DEF penetration come from the owner; DEF and DEF reduction from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l087: The damage element is confirmed by the official hit or damage entry; penetration from the owner, RES and RES reduction from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l088: The target's DMG Taken increase at that moment.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l091: Blossom reads no ATK/HP/DEF panel and no general or element DMG Bonus, and cannot crit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l092: One Blossom plant makes 5 flowers, with at most 3 plants; that is state and hit count, not a factor in the per-flower formula.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l097: Records qualifying actual Anima/Incantation damage and adds it again with the original element when the 12 seconds end.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l098: Hexed follow-up = Actual original damage × [(Copy ratio + Linko copy ratio bonus) × (1 + Follow-up Attack DMG Bonus%) × Intensity term + clamp(Intensity term - 1, 0, 100)] × Final multiplier
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l099: The one real damage Hexed recorded; never regenerated from an expected panel.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l101: Inherits each original damage's element: Anima stays Anima, Incantation stays Incantation.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l102: From the character who actually dealt the recorded damage; not the QTE character who triggered Hexed, and no comparison of both Cycle sides.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l106: 10% when the team has Linko's Weakness Radar active, 0% otherwise.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l108: This page splits it as 10% with Weakness Radar active and 0% without; it multiplies only the copied part, not the clamp term after it.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l112: 1 + 20% × Cycle Intensity / (Cycle Intensity + 180); Cycle Intensity counts as at least 0.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l114: Clamp the intensity term minus one to between 0 and 100.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l116: Keeps the DMG Bonus already settled in the original damage without dividing it out; if the original already had Follow-up Attack DMG Bonus, that gain stays in the actual value.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l118: The current core model uses 1; the original's final DMG Bonus is not multiplied in twice.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l119: Hexed does not read the Cycle 16-tier base damage table; its base is actual damage that happened and was officially recorded.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l120: This explains how the current 33% splits; it is not independently confirmed that the game settles the two 10% steps this way, and other Follow-up Attack DMG Bonus sources are not substituted on that basis.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l121: 33% is the copied total; the final added damage also depends on Cycle Intensity, so it is not a fixed 33% of the original, and the whole Hexed hit is not multiplied by 1.10 again.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l122: When the state is removed early it is not settled at once by default, unless a specific effect explicitly says so.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l126: 16-tier base value × pre-settlement stacks × Cycle Intensity × target-side multipliers × DOT and CRIT.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l127: One Scorch tick = floor[Level base × Pre-settlement stacks × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × DEF × RES × Vulnerability × DoT-specific final term × CRIT branch]
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l128: Compare "level base × Cycle Intensity" for both Cycle participants and take the higher; not always the QTE character, and never added together.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l129: Each participant first reads the Scorch source tier for their own level; the normal and Zankou curves are both 2,700 at level 80.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l131: Normal Scorch is fixed at 1 stack; Zankou's replacement state advances on the official DoT application axis of the same half and target, up to 3.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l132: Each participant's own Cycle Intensity enters the comparison; this Scorch then freezes the winner's intensity and character-side variables.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l133: Character level/penetration from the owner; enemy DEF/DEF reduction from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l134: Normal Scorch uses the actual element confirmed per hit; Zankou's always uses Incantation. Penetration from the owner, RES from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l136: The official DoT types still active on the target before the hit, and final DMG Bonuses explicitly limited to DoT.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l138: Fixed 50% CRIT Rate; the character's CRIT Rate is ignored, but the owner's CRIT DMG is used.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l139: Scorch reads neither the character's ATK panel nor general/element DMG Bonus.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l140: Scorch's own ticks do not recursively add Zankou Scorch stacks; without an official application event no stack count may be inferred from the final damage.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l144: Settles Mental damage after 5 seconds. It skips the DEF multiplier but still passes through Mental RES and vulnerability.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l145: One Nova = floor[Level base × (1 + Cycle Intensity/600) × Mental RES × Vulnerability]
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l147: Compare "level base × Cycle Intensity" for both participants and take the higher; each trigger instance keeps its own winner.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l148: Both sides read the Nova source tier for their own level; the winning instance freezes that value, 45,000 at level 80.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l149: Each side compares with its own Cycle Intensity; the winning instance uses only the winner's, never the sum.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l150: Mental damage is treated as 100% DEF penetration, so the DEF term is fixed at 1.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l151: Mental penetration from the instance owner; Mental RES and RES reduction from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l152: The target's DMG Taken increase at the settlement moment.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l153: Nova reads no ATK panel, general DMG Bonus or CRIT.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l154: When several instances settle together each keeps its own source stats; the two Cycle Intensities are never added and computed once.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l158: Lasts 12 seconds after a QTE triggers it; each of the team's later hits reads the Cycle Intensity of its own damage source character.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l159: This hit's Stain final term = 1.20 × [1 + 20% × source Cycle Intensity / (source Cycle Intensity + 180)]; boosted hit = original full damage × this hit's Stain final term
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l161: Only triggers or refreshes Stain; its Cycle Intensity is not frozen as a shared 12-second value for the team.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l163: The character actually dealing this boosted hit in the window; they supply the Cycle Intensity for this hit's Stain formula.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l165: The official Cycle constant 20%, which makes the leading 1.20.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l167: Uses this hit's source Cycle Intensity: 1 + 20% × Cycle Intensity / (Cycle Intensity + 180).
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l169: The official Cycle constant of 12 seconds, starting after the triggering QTE settles; later triggers refresh the window.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l171: Every team member's later hits in the window; characters get different terms because their Cycle Intensities differ.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l172: Stain is a team final DMG Bonus Buff; it creates no separate "Stain damage" and does not record damage to settle at the end of the 12 seconds.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l173: Team Break and non-per-hit Max HP settlements do not use this final term by default for now.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l174: If a hit's actual source cannot be confirmed the state may be shown, but its Cycle Intensity gain must stay unresolved rather than fall back to the QTE trigger or a nearby hit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l179: Lakshana + Cosmos; 5 seconds of reduced ATK and speed, with no damage formula of its own.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l180: Remora damage = not applicable; the state lasts 5 seconds
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l182: The target; only mechanisms that explicitly require Remora use it afterwards.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l183: Remora creates no hits and cannot be entered as direct or Cycle damage.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l188: Cosmos + Anima + Lakshana; a Blossom flower hitting a Remora target grants 10 extra Finisher energy.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l189: Extra Ultimate Energy = 10 (when a Blossom flower hits a target under Remora)
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l191: The target's state axis before the hit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l193: From official Blossom damage/hit evidence, never guessed from a Chinese skill name.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l194: Charge changes resources and creates no damage directly.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l198: Chaos + Psyche + Incantation; it removes Break value when the target has both Nova and Scorch, and deals no damage itself.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l199: Current project projection: Discord Break deduction = target's Break cap × 15%
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l201: From the state axis of the same half and target, never spliced across targets.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l202: Only the Break cap in the target's frozen stat pack, never from either participant.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l203: 15% is not yet a complete official runtime formula; it only takes part in the Break bar timeline, not in the Break damage terms.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l206: 15% is the project's current weak-evidence default; the flat value, level coefficient and multiplayer correction are still unconfirmed.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l209: Official skill multiplier × this tick's state coefficient × the attacker's per-hit panel × target-side multipliers × DOT and CRIT.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l210: Tick damage = floor[Skill base multiplier × Tick state coefficient × Attacker's scaling panel × DMG Bonus × DEF × RES × Vulnerability × Independent final term × DoT-specific final term × CRIT branch]
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l212: From Lacrimosa's official Nightmare damage entry and the current effective Basic Attack level; the normal and awakening-6 branches each use their own tier.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l214: Each valid official direct hit applies 1 stack; a tick reads only earlier stacks, up to 10. Each stack lasts 3 seconds on its own, 6 after awakening 4.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l216: The DoT source character's frozen growth, equipment and active Buffs at the hit.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l218: From this hit's target; penetration from the damage source, DEF/RES reduction and Vulnerability from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l219: The official DoT types still active on the same target before the hit, and final DMG Bonuses explicitly limited to DoT.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l220: Fixed 50% CRIT Rate; the character's CRIT Rate is ignored, while the crit branch still uses the source's CRIT DMG.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l221: The awakening-3 early settlement is a separate formula (sum each stack's remaining ticks, then clear); without a stable link it must not pass as a normal tick.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l225: From Zankou's official Heartwrench damage entry and the current effective Basic Attack level.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l226: Official active stacks are kept apart from this tick's coefficient; the actual damage picks only between "one share" and "official stacks before this hit", up to 10.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l227: No free fitting across 1–10; without an application event a coefficient of 1 only means at least one share, with low confidence.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l231: From Zankou's official Vile Ash damage entry and the current effective Ultimate level.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l232: The final application point of Bloodfeast Reverie adds 5 stacks at once, up to 10, lasting 30 seconds; Basic Attacks and DoT ticks add none.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l233: Spreading copies the stacks, remaining time and period, but a single-target axis must not use it to invent hits on other targets.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l238: Each character in the same half computes the five multipliers separately, and every character's contribution is then summed.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l239: Team Break = Σ over same-half characters i [Level base_i × (1 + Break Intensity_i/300 + Σ Break DMG Bonus_i) × Enemy Break cap term × DEF_i × RES_i]
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l241: Every official damage-dealing character in this hit's half; the triggering character Core names is not the sole damage owner.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l243: Each character uses the official level 1–80 Break curve at their own level; 3,603 at level 80.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l244: Each character uses their own "base × (1 + increase) + flat extra"; nothing is merged across the team first.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l246: Enters only the slot of the character providing it; the Break state itself gives no Vulnerability.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l248: From the same target's UnbalMax: normally max(1, UnbalMax/3), fixed at 25 for Hunter's Crucible high-tier bosses.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l249: Each slot uses that character's level and DEF penetration; target DEF/DEF reduction come from the same target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l250: Each slot takes its own penetration for the character's inherent element, and reads the target's matching RES/RES reduction.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l251: Break reads no ATK/HP/DEF scaling panel, general DMG Bonus, Vulnerability, CRIT or independent final DMG Bonus.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l252: With an incomplete half team or target profile it must be marked not fully replayable, never filled in from the other half.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l257: Uses Daffodill's own five Break multipliers; the candidate awakening 5 adds 1 + Insight stacks extra settlements.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l258: One personal Break = Daffodill level base × Daffodill Break Intensity term × target Break cap term × Daffodill DEF term × Chaos RES term; candidate awakening-5 total = 1 + Insight stacks
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l260: Level, Break Intensity, DEF penetration and Chaos penetration all come from Daffodill, not the rest of the team.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l262: Break cap, DEF, Chaos RES and matching debuffs come from the target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l264: From Daffodill's own fixed-axis state; one stack before awakening 3, up to two after.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l265: An extra Break GE only proves the formula anchor, not that awakening 5 is active.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l266: The candidate's added row has a zero baseline and does not replace the original team Break damage.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l272: 200% of the source Nightmare's own damage; the effective HP loss is then scaled by the pre-settlement HP ratio.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l273: Expected Max HP cut = source Nightmare damage × 200%; effective HP loss = Max HP drop × clamp(pre-settlement HP / old Max HP, 0, 1)
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l275: Lacrimosa's official Nightmare hits on the same target with clear attribution; the damage change inherits that hit's formula ratio.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l277: Old/new Max HP and pre-settlement HP all come from the continuous HP axis of the same half and target.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l278: Attributed to Lacrimosa; the target's HP data only decides the effective loss, not the source character.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l279: Description estimates stay separate from Core's official Max HP drops; without a continuous target axis it stays partial/unavailable.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l284: Shares 300%/600% of the damage Fadia actually took, capped cumulatively at 8%/25% of her max HP.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l285: Shareable now = min(Fadia's actual damage taken × share ratio, cumulative cap - shared so far); cumulative cap = Fadia's Max HP × cap ratio
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l287: Only Fadia's own reliable damage taken after shields and team sharing, never the enemy's raw outgoing damage packet.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l289: From Fadia's normal or awakening-2 branch of this mechanism.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l290: Fadia's current Max HP, not the enemy's or the sharing target's.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l292: The running total already shared by this mechanism instance.
messages.static_catalog.formulas.label.l293: Current battle-report damage-taken evidence may precede shield/sharing settlement; with too little evidence it must not simply be multiplied by 3 or 6.
